## History

[Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) was sent from the States to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to live with his grandmother, who raised him according to traditional principles regarding moral conduct and eating habits. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) later brought [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to meet Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), his father Stephen's former fiancée, and the two quickly bonded during their visit. Stanhope eventually reunited with [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), embracing her in the garden before the couple was later married.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), +8 more_

## Relationships

### [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cedric-stanhope--stanhope.md)

Stanhope is the parent of [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) as of Volume 2. Their family connection also extends through Cedric's grandmother.

### [Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/grandma-stanhope--stanhope.md)

[Grandma Stanhope](../character/grandma-stanhope.md) is the paternal grandmother in the family who is raising her grandson. She shares a generational family relation with Stanhope.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)_

- Relative of — paternal grandmother raising her grandson  <sub>[v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P12](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0012)</sub>
